第1268章 虚无之地（第1页）
法宝围绕着赵洁旋转，灵气微微波动，一如赵洁此刻的心情。
因为在赵洁眼中，这里什么都没有。
这里没有天与地，没有边与界，没有光亮，没有物体，没有声音。
若非灵宝散发的灵气光芒，此方天地定当伸手不见五指。
赵洁沉默许久，忽的嫣然一笑：“也是，祖巫帝江沉睡之地，便是‘虚无之地’，自当什么都没有。
不过……外来的物体或生灵，能否在此地长久存在？”
赵洁黛眉紧锁，自言自语道：“若是能，这里为何什么都没有？若是不能——”
因为悬浮于她身周的诸多灵宝，有至少三件消失不见了！
这并非法宝破损，或被屏蔽了神念，那三件……不，应该是四件！
四件法宝，在悄无声息间被蚕食掉了。
赵洁亲眼目睹了这一幕，她的一杆魂幡，像是被随手擦掉的灰尘。
若非魂幡就在眼前消失，若非亲眼目睹，赵洁根本不敢相信这一幕。
因为哪怕法宝消失，她的神魂也没有丝毫受损！
赵洁再次察觉到不对劲，她感觉体表的衣衫在变薄。
赵洁身周的一切法宝全部‘消失’，就连她那件法器衣裳，也逐渐被此地虚无蚕食掉。
那匀称丰腴的身子，更是止不住的发抖。
因为她感知到，她体内的灵气、生机，也在缓慢流逝。

一朵蓝色的灵气火焰凭空绽放，点亮黑暗。
赵洁眸中折射着灵气火焰的光，让脸色苍白的她，多了几分柔弱。
为何七彩主宁愿在七彩宗枯等，也不愿派弟子或者一尊分身，于此地等候！
甚至对于能获取到空间法则的重要情报，也没刻意隐瞒，让她的分身轻而易举的窃取到。
这方虚无空间，会悄无声息的‘蚕食’掉一切！
不论是活人还是死人，不论法宝还是法器。
“七彩主根本不在乎情报被窃，因为没有人能在这里活下来……”
赵洁下意识攥拳，脑中莫名浮现出，始终戴着面具从未以真面目示人的七彩主。
那个懒散躺在座椅上，那个始终和颜悦色语气柔和的男人，是不是故意让她来当探路的小白鼠？
“我竟也有被当棋子的一日，今日……莫非要折在这里？倒是可惜了这具分身。”
她并未等待死亡来临，而是不计代价的散出神念，快速向四周探索。
任凭赵洁如何探索，却什么也搜索不到。

Chapter 1268 The Land of Nothingness (Page 1)
The magic weapon revolves around Zhao Jie, and the spiritual energy fluctuates slightly, just like Zhao Jie's mood at the moment.
Because in Zhao Jie's eyes, there is nothing here.
There is no heaven and earth, no boundaries, no light, no objects, no sound.
If it weren't for the light of spiritual energy emitted by the Lingbao, the world in this area would be completely invisible.
Zhao Jie was silent for a long time, then suddenly smiled: "That's right, the place where Zu Wu Emperor Jiang slept is the 'Land of Nothingness', so it's natural to think that there is nothing.
But... can foreign objects or creatures exist here for a long time? "
Zhao Jiedai frowned and said to herself: "If it can be done, why is there nothing here? If it can't be -"
Because at least three of the many spiritual treasures suspended around her disappeared!
This is not because the magic weapon is damaged or the spiritual thoughts are blocked. Those three pieces... no, it should be four!
The four magic weapons were eaten away quietly.
Zhao Jie witnessed this scene with her own eyes. Her soul flag looked like dust that had been wiped off casually.
If the soul flag hadn't disappeared in front of his eyes, if he hadn't witnessed it with his own eyes, Zhao Jie would not have believed this scene.
Because even if the magic weapon disappeared, her soul was not damaged at all!
Zhao Jie noticed something was wrong again. She felt that the clothes on her body were getting thinner.
All the magic weapons around Zhao Jie 'disappeared', and even her magic weapon and clothes were gradually eaten away by the void here.
That well-proportioned and plump body could not stop trembling.
Because she sensed that the spiritual energy and vitality in her body were slowly passing away.
A blue aura flame bloomed out of thin air, lighting up the darkness.
The light of the spiritual energy flame reflected in Zhao Jie's eyes, making her pale face look a little more fragile.
Why would the Qicai Lord rather wait in the Qicai Sect than send a disciple or a clone to wait here!
She even did not deliberately hide the important information about the laws of space, allowing her clone to steal it easily.
This empty space will quietly 'eat' away everything!
Whether it is a living person or a dead person, whether it is a magic weapon or a magic weapon.
"Lord Qicai doesn't care about the theft of information at all, because no one can survive here..."
Zhao Jie clenched her fists subconsciously, and an inexplicable image emerged in her mind of the Colorful Lord, who always wore a mask and never showed his true face.
Did that man lying lazily on the seat, that man who always had a pleasant face and a soft voice, deliberately let her be a guinea pig?
"There was a day when I was used as a pawn. Today...does it have to be here? It's a pity for this clone."
She did not wait for death to come. Instead, she sent out her spiritual thoughts regardless of the cost and quickly explored the surroundings.
No matter how Zhao Jie searched, he couldn't find anything.
